findings.title: Explicit GPU architecture target
findings.interpretation: Text signal only; reachability, precedence and effective runtime configuration are unverified.
findings.suggested_change: Compare declared targets with the selected GPU compute capability. Inspect built artifacts for compatible cubin/PTX; a text flag does not establish what ships. Architecture-specific a/f targets need separate compatibility review.
findings.validation: Inspect actual artifacts and build logs; run representative custom kernels on each target. If appropriate, test the documented PTX JIT path separately and unset diagnostic overrides afterward.
findings.target_context: Selected target GPU compute capability is 9.0. Compare actual compiled artifacts and dispatch support; different text targets alone do not establish incompatibility.

findings.title: Distributed training or state-sharding signal
findings.interpretation: Text signal only; reachability, precedence and effective runtime configuration are unverified.
findings.suggested_change: Preserve optimizer/checkpoint semantics while reviewing FSDP/ZeRO/DDP groups, communication frequency and CPU offload for the new topology.
findings.validation: Compare gradients/loss, effective batch, max-rank memory, step time, checkpoint restore and recovery under the target layout.

findings.title: Potential host/device transfer or CPU offload
findings.interpretation: Text signal only; reachability, precedence and effective runtime configuration are unverified.
findings.suggested_change: Check whether the transfer is on the critical path, intended checkpoint/output work, or offload. Review batching, placement and overlap before changing it.
findings.validation: Profile representative execution for H2D/D2H copies, synchronization and CPU gaps; compare quality and unprofiled end-to-end results after any change.

findings.title: Host preprocessing or data-loader signal

findings.validation: Measure host-stage latency and GPU idle gaps under representative input, concurrency and storage conditions.

known_issue_policy: None asserted from text alone. A flag or declared version is not a resolved artifact or an executed path; an empty list is not evidence of compatibility.

runtime_unknowns.detail: Installed driver/runtime, resolved dependencies, image digest, external or generated configuration, branch reachability and built cubin/PTX are unknown.
Cannot deduce effective NCCL/P2P/EFA transport, fallback, overlap or custom communication from static text.
Cannot determine per-rank memory fit, numerical quality, throughput, latency, cost or certify portability without target-hardware tests.

validation_matrix.required_evidence: Exact image, driver/runtime, host ISA, GPU compute capability and custom-kernel correctness on each source/target profile.
Peak allocated/reserved memory on every rank at the largest supported shapes, context, concurrency or training batch; valid TP/PP/DP partitioning.
H2D/D2H and peer copies for relevant size/pair/NUMA placements, then application traces showing effective transfer paths.
Actual rank layout and message sizes; NCCL/provider logs on every rank; intended plugin/EFA selection and custom non-NCCL paths.
Predeclared quality/SLO acceptance, representative load/tails, warm/cold starts, independent repetitions, goodput and cost per qualifying result.
Drain/failure/restart, checkpoint restore where relevant, replacement capacity, and a verified rollback profile.

safety.notes: Allowlisted technical tokens and sanitized relative paths only. Paths and dependency versions can still be confidential; review locally before sharing.

method_limitations: Lexical patterns, not AST/data-flow analysis; inline comments, quoted strings, examples and dead code can match.
Full-line comments are skipped. Test/example paths are labelled, not excluded. Aliases, computed values, split-line assignments and unsupported formats may be missed.

No requirements includes, imports, submodule metadata, symlinks, hardlinks, container images or external paths are resolved. Materialized nested files may be scanned. No binary introspection or vulnerability diagnosis.
Bounded UTF-8 allowlist scan with a documented .gitignore subset; unsupported/unreadable ignore policy skips its whole subtree.
File extensions and filenames can hide relevant code; no findings never means no migration work.
